about: Free compute credits any developer can get, startup or not: GPU, CPU, inference, CI and hosting. Each row was read on the vendor's own page (source) on its checked date. A free tier changes without notice, so read the source page before you sign up.

rows.name: Comfy Cloud Free plan
rows.free_amount: 5 free runs on real GPUs and free Comfy Agent credits for new users.
who_qualifies: New Comfy Cloud users.
setup_steps: Create an account on comfy.org.
Open Comfy Cloud in the browser and run a workflow.
When the free runs are used, the agent pauses until credits are added; add none.

rows.name: Hugging Face ZeroGPU (free account)
rows.free_amount: 5 minutes of ZeroGPU time per day on a free account (2 minutes unauthenticated) across any ZeroGPU Space. The default size is half an NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell with 48 GB VRAM.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a free Hugging Face account.
Hosting up to 2 ZeroGPU Spaces needs a personal account in good standing: verified email, older than 30 days.
setup_steps: Create a free account on huggingface.co and verify the email.
Sign in with hf auth login, which prompts for a token; never pass it as an argument.
Open a ZeroGPU Space and run it; usage stops at the daily quota.

rows.name: Modal Starter
rows.free_amount: $30 per month of included compute (GPU, CPU, memory) for Functions and Sandboxes on the Starter plan, with 10 GPU concurrency and 100 containers.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Modal account.
Using a GPU requires a valid payment method on file.
setup_steps: Create an account at modal.com and add a payment method.
Sign in with modal setup, which opens the browser.
Set the workspace spend limit to $0 so workloads stop when the included credit is used.
Run a Function with a GPU and watch the usage page.

rows.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free (OCI Ampere A1 Compute)
rows.free_amount: 1,500 OCPU hours and 9,000 GB hours per month on VM.Standard.A1.Flex (Arm), which Oracle states equals 2 OCPUs and 12 GB of memory. Also 200 GB of boot and block volume storage and up to two AMD E2.1.Micro VMs.
who_qualifies: Anyone who opens an Oracle Cloud Free Tier account.
A credit or debit card for identity verification; prepaid, virtual and PIN debit cards are refused.
setup_steps: Sign up for the Oracle Cloud Free Tier and verify the card.
Sign in with oci session authenticate, which opens the browser.
Stay on the Free Tier: paid resources need an upgrade, so usage cannot run past the limits.
Keep instances in use: Oracle may reclaim one whose CPU, network and memory stay under 20% for 7 days.

rows.name: AssemblyAI free credit
rows.free_amount: Up to $50 of audio on a limited trial: pre-recorded transcription, Speech Understanding and streaming speech-to-text.
who_qualifies: New AssemblyAI accounts; no card at sign-up.
setup_steps: Create an AssemblyAI account.
Copy the API key from the dashboard into your keychain or secret store, never into a command.
Once the $50 is used, the API returns an error until you add a card; add none.

rows.name: Cerebras Inference Free Trial
rows.free_amount: $5 in credits after adding a verified payment method, valid 30 days, with gpt-oss-120b at 5 requests a minute and 1 million tokens a day.
who_qualifies: New Cerebras Inference accounts with a verified payment method.
For development, evaluation and experimentation, not production.
setup_steps: Create a Cerebras Inference account and add a payment method.
Create an API key in the console and keep it in your keychain or secret store, never in a command.
Access pauses when the credit runs out or expires after 30 days.

rows.name: Cloudflare AI Search (formerly AutoRAG)
rows.free_amount: Monthly: 5 million ingestion tokens, 10 GB-month storage, 1,000 semantic queries and 1,000 full-text queries, on Workers Free and Workers Paid.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Cloudflare account.
setup_steps: Create a Cloudflare account.
Sign in with wrangler login, which opens the browser.
Create an AI Search instance in the dashboard.
Usage past the monthly amount is metered: stop at the free amount yourself.

rows.name: Cloudflare Workers AI free daily allocation
rows.free_amount: 10,000 Neurons per day of Workers AI inference, on both Workers Free and Workers Paid.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Cloudflare account.
setup_steps: Create a Cloudflare account.
Sign in with wrangler login, which opens the browser.
Stay on Workers Free: use past the daily allocation fails with an error instead of billing.

rows.name: ElevenLabs Free
rows.free_amount: 10,000 credits per month, about 10 minutes of text to speech (1 credit per character on V2 Multilingual), and 3 Studio projects.
who_qualifies: Anyone with an ElevenLabs account, for non-commercial use only.
setup_steps: Create an ElevenLabs account on the Free plan.
Opt out of training on your content in the settings, if you want that.
No spend cap is named on the page read: stop at the free amount yourself.

rows.name: GroqCloud Free plan
rows.free_amount: A Free plan with per-model rate limits. Groq's rate-limits page names Free plan limits but shows only the Developer plan's base limits, such as whisper-large-v3 at 20 requests a minute, 2,000 requests a day and 28,800 audio seconds a day, so read your own limits in the console.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a GroqCloud account on the Free plan. The figures shown are the Developer plan's base limits, the only ones the page shows.
setup_steps: Create an account in the GroqCloud console.
Create an API key in the console and keep it in your keychain or secret store, never in a command.
Stay on the Free plan; requests over a limit get HTTP 429.

rows.name: Mistral Studio Free mode
rows.free_amount: API access on a new Mistral Studio account in Free mode, enabled by default with no credit card. Rate limits apply; the docs give no numbers.
who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a Mistral Studio account.
setup_steps: Create a Mistral Studio account.
Create an API key in Studio and keep it in your keychain or secret store, never in a command.
Opt out of training on your inputs in the settings, if you want that.

rows.name: NVIDIA API Catalog trial (build.nvidia.com)
rows.free_amount: Free inference on hosted models in the API Catalog, up to 40 requests a minute and 10,000 requests a day.
who_qualifies: Anyone with an NVIDIA account, for internal testing and evaluation only, not production.
setup_steps: Create an NVIDIA account on build.nvidia.com.
Generate an API key on a model page and keep it in your keychain or secret store, never in a command.
Use it for testing only; production needs a paid subscription.

rows.name: OpenRouter free model variants (:free)
rows.free_amount: Free model variants (:free) at 20 requests a minute and 50 requests a day, or 1,000 a day after at least 10 credits purchased in all time.
who_qualifies: Anyone with an OpenRouter account.
setup_steps: Create an account on openrouter.ai.
Create an API key in the settings and keep it in your keychain or secret store, never in a command.
Call only model ids ending in :free, and keep the balance at or above zero.
Turn on the privacy setting that stops routing to providers that train, if you want that.

rows.name: Blacksmith free tier
rows.free_amount: 3,000 x64 2 vCPU minutes per month per organization for GitHub Actions jobs.
who_qualifies: Any GitHub organization that installs the Blacksmith app.
setup_steps: Install the Blacksmith GitHub app on your organization.
Change a job's runs-on label to a Blacksmith runner.
The pages read do not say what happens past the free minutes: watch usage and stop at 3,000.

rows.name: GitHub Actions on GitHub Free
rows.free_amount: Standard GitHub-hosted runners in public repositories are free. Private repositories get $12 of included compute per month on GitHub Free; at $0.006 per Linux 2-core minute, that covers 2,000 minutes (computed here).
who_qualifies: Anyone with a GitHub account on GitHub Free.
setup_steps: Sign in with gh auth login, which opens the browser.
Add a workflow under .github/workflows that runs on a standard runner.
Leave no payment method on file, or set a budget that stops usage at $0.

rows.name: Cloudflare D1 on Workers Free
rows.free_amount: 5 million rows read per day, 100,000 rows written per day, 5 GB total storage and 10 databases.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Cloudflare account on Workers Free.
setup_steps: Create a Cloudflare account.
Sign in with wrangler login, which opens the browser.
Create a database with wrangler d1 create; past a daily limit, queries fail until reset.

rows.name: Cloudflare R2 free tier
rows.free_amount: 10 GB-month storage, 1 million Class A operations and 10 million Class B operations per month, with free egress, on Standard storage.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Cloudflare account who adds an R2 subscription through checkout.
setup_steps: Create a Cloudflare account and add the R2 subscription in the dashboard.
Sign in with wrangler login, which opens the browser.
Usage above the free tier bills: stop at the free amount yourself.

rows.name: Cloudflare Workers Free plan
rows.free_amount: 100,000 requests per day, 10 ms CPU time per invocation and 128 MB memory, plus Workers KV at 100,000 reads and 1,000 writes per day.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Cloudflare account.
setup_steps: Create a Cloudflare account.
Sign in with wrangler login, which opens the browser.
Deploy with wrangler deploy; past the daily limit, Cloudflare returns Error 1027 instead of billing.

rows.name: GitHub Pages
rows.free_amount: Static site hosting for public repositories. A published site is up to 1 GB, with a soft bandwidth limit of 100 GB per month and a soft limit of 10 builds per hour.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a GitHub account, for a public repository.
Not for an online business, e-commerce or commercial SaaS.
setup_steps: Sign in with gh auth login, which opens the browser.
Turn on Pages in the repository settings and pick a branch or workflow.

rows.name: Hugging Face Spaces CPU Basic
rows.free_amount: Static Spaces are free for everyone. CPU Basic hardware is 2 vCPU, 16 GB RAM and 50 GB of non-persistent disk.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Hugging Face account, for a static Space.
A new CPU Basic Gradio or Docker Space needs a paid plan.
setup_steps: Create a free account on huggingface.co.
Sign in with hf auth login, which prompts for a token; never pass it as an argument.
Create a static Space and push your site.

rows.name: Supabase Free plan
rows.free_amount: 2 active projects; per project a 500 MB database, 1 GB file storage, 5 GB egress, 50,000 monthly active users and 500,000 Edge Function invocations.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Supabase account.
setup_steps: Create a Supabase account and a project on the Free plan.
Sign in with supabase login, which opens the browser.
Free projects pause after 1 week of inactivity. No spend cap is named on the page read: stop at the free amount yourself.

rows.name: Vercel Hobby plan
rows.free_amount: Per month: 1 million function invocations, 4 hours Fluid Active CPU, 1 million CDN requests and 100 GB Fast Data Transfer.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a Vercel account, for personal, non-commercial use only.
setup_steps: Create a Vercel account on the Hobby plan.
Sign in with vercel login, which opens the browser.
Deploy with vercel; Hobby stops at its limits.
